# Design and plan authorship

**Input:** resume `author-plan`, reconciled dossier, current draft plan and exact source/configuration receipts.

**Read:** [full plan policy](../delivery-rules.md#plan-and-approval), [design recipe](../work-item-design.md), [spec guidance](../work-item-spec.md) when a specification is requested, and [working PR draft](../working-pr-draft.md).

**Skills:** invoke available `pstack:architect` (its one configured `pstack:arena`), then `pstack:interrogate` on the selected sketch/rationale. Reuse how/why grounding. Apply the configured role models; missing required seats are incomplete evidence.

**Action:** follow the design recipe without architect's automatic implementation. Preserve candidates, judgment, findings/dispositions and exact bindings. Resolve Act On findings. Bind case/source/convention coverage, paths, branch/baseline, dependencies, tests/before-after proof, QA ownership and realistic AI/human/wait ranges into the final plan; update the existing PR rationale. Validate the current design package, init/render through existing commands, and show the complete concrete plan in chat.

**Output:** final developer plan and approval hash, current checked design package and exact unresolved holds.

**Stop/return:** wait only when required genuine approval or a decision is missing. Record approval already given against the exact applicable plan. Changed full inputs require the prescribed renewed package/approval; unchanged valid packages are reused. No product branch/edits before approval. Resume; approved-action precedence never opens a new design panel.
